spans.s:
Uṣyala occurs once in the description of the couch or the
bridal car in the Atharvaveda,^1 where it seems to mean the four
‘frame-pieces.’ The form is doubtful: uṣpala is possible.^2
1) xiv. 1, 60.
2) Whitney, Translation of the Athar-
vaveda, 385.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 155;
Whitney, op. cit., 752.
